result.topic_en: Fragment 60: finding two rational right triangles with areas A = pq(pp-qq) and B = rs(rr-ss) whose ratio is a given a:b, with seven particular solutions obtained by special substitutions for r and s.
result.transcription:
224 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.
60.
Problema. Invenire duo triangula rectangula in numeris, quorum areae
$A = pq(pp-qq)$ et $B = rs(rr-ss)$
datam inter se teneant rationem scil. $a:b$, ita ut sit $\frac{A}{B} = \frac{a}{b}$.
Hoc problema methodo directa frustra tractatur, unde ad solutiones particulares confugere necesse est cujusmodi sunt sequentes:
I. Sumatur $r = p$ et $s = p - q$, erit $r + s = 2p - q$ et $r - s = q$, unde fit
$B = p(p-q)(2p-q)q$
hincque $\frac{A}{B} = \frac{p+q}{2p-q} = \frac{a}{b}$, ergo $bp + bq = 2ap - aq$, ideoque $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a+b}{2a-b}$, unde haec solutio nascitur
$p = a + b$ $r = a + b$
$q = 2a - b$ $s = 2b - a$.
II. Sit $r = 2p$ et $s = p + q$, erit $r + s = 3p + q$ et $r - s = p - q$, hinc $B = 2p(p+q)(3p+q)(p-q)$, ergo
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{q}{6p+2q} = \frac{a}{b}$, sicque erit $bq = 6ap + 2aq$, indeque $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{b-2a}{6a}$,
quocirca capiatur $p = b - 2a$ $r = 2b - 4a$
$q = 6a$ $s = b + 4a$.
III. Sit $r = 2p$ et $s = p - q$, erit $r + s = 3p - q$, et $r - s = p + q$, hinc
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{q}{6p-2q} = \frac{a}{b}$, sicque $bq = 6ap - 2aq$, ergo $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{b+2a}{6a}$,
quocirca capiatur pro ista solutione $p = b + 2a$ $r = 2b + 4a$
$q = 6a$ $s = b - 4a$.
IV. Sit $r = p + q$ et $s = p$, erit $r + s = 2p + q$ et $r - s = q$, hincque
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{p-q}{2p+q} = \frac{a}{b}$, unde colligitur ob $bp - bq = 2ap + aq$, $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a+b}{b-2a}$
ergo capiantur $p = a + b$ $r = 2b - a$
$q = b - 2a$ $s = a + b$.
V. Sit $r = p + q$ et $s = q$, erit $r + s = p + 2q$ et $r - s = p$, unde fit
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{p-q}{p+2q} = \frac{a}{b}$, inde $bp - bq = ap + 2aq$, hinc $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{2a+b}{b-a}$,
quocirca capere debemus $p = 2a + b$ $r = a + 2b$
$q = b - a$ $s = b - a$.
VI. Sit $r = p + q$ et $s = 2q$, erit $r + s = p + 3q$ et $r - s = p - q$, unde fit
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{p}{2p+6q} = \frac{a}{b}$, unde ob $bp = 2ap + 6aq$, erit $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{6a}{b-2a}$,
ideoque hic capere oportet $p = 6a$ $r = 4a + b$
$q = b - 2a$ $s = 2b - 4a$.
VII. Sit $r = p - q$ et $s = q$, erit $r + s = p$ et $r - s = p - 2q$ et erit
$\frac{A}{B} = \frac{p+q}{p-2q} = \frac{a}{b}$, ideoque $bp + bq = ap - 2aq$, hinc $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{b+2a}{a-b}$,
itaque ut capiatur necesse est $p = b + 2a$ $r = 2b + a$
$q = a - b$ $s = a - b$.

methods.what: Areas of rational right triangles from generators p,q and r,s
Substitution r=p, s=p-q reduces ratio condition to linear equation in p/q
